experiment: E1.5.3: single-UE NR link-level mapping. 5G-LENA SNR -> spectral efficiency per used resource (NR LDPC error model, AMC at 10% BLER target, HARQ) against the TR 36.942 attenuated and truncated Shannon mapping used in E1.3-E1.4
status: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-11-08, committed before the first measured run; grid, metric, fit, checks and decision rules are not changed after results are seen
why: E1.3/E1.4 map SNR to rate with TR 36.942 V19 Annex A.1 (DL alpha 0.6, Thr_max 4.4; UL alpha 0.4, Thr_max 2.0; SNR_min -10 dB), E-UTRA-era values. Under F2 (10 users time-sharing) the UL needs link SE 1.5 bit/s/Hz, i.e. 10.95 dB with alpha 0.4. The UL feasibility result depends on this mapping
seen_before_registration: one smoke point on a synthetic loss (110 dB at 3.5 GHz, NrEesmIrT2): DL MCS 27, 6.32 bit/s/Hz per used resource; UL MCS 7, 1.63 bit/s/Hz. No other point, no fit

stack.program: ns3/scratch/cmwave/e15-link-validation.cc mode link (E1.5.1) with --errorModel=<TypeId> (sets the DL and UL error model of the AMCs and of decoding); without it mode link is unchanged (check R3)

source_facts: the NR default error model of AMC and decoding is NrLteMiErrorModel (LTE MI-based); NR LDPC models are NrEesmIrT1 (MCS table 1, up to 64QAM) and NrEesmIrT2 (MCS table 2, up to 256QAM), IR HARQ combining

NrHelper::SetDlErrorModel sets the gNB DL AMC and the UE spectrum PHY; the UE's DL AMC is created from the gNB DL AMC factory (nr-helper.cc line 538), so the UE's CQI uses the same model; SetUlErrorModel sets the gNB UL AMC and gNB spectrum PHY
NrAmc with AmcModel ErrorModel selects the highest MCS with TBLER <= 0.1 (nr-amc.cc)
control channels are ideal in 5G-LENA, so DL feedback works whatever the UL data quality

setup.ue: one UE, isotropic 1x1 at both ends, no fading, no shadowing, prescribed loss (mode link, as E1.5.1)
setup.carrier_note: the mapping depends on SNR only (AWGN, no Doppler); one carrier suffices; E1.5.1 showed the SNR identity at both carriers
setup.common: E1.5.1 common settings: 20 MHz, numerology 1, 51 RBs (RbOverhead 0.073), 44 dBm gNB (UniformPowerAllocBw), 23 dBm UE (UniformPowerAllocUsed, no UL power control), NF 5/7 dB, DDDSU
setup.scheduler: ns3::NrMacSchedulerTdmaPF (single UE: every RB of every data symbol it is given)
setup.traffic: saturating UDP CBR both directions at once: DL 300 Mbit/s, UL 100 Mbit/s, 1000-byte packets (above the 20 MHz capacity)
setup.grid_note: DL SNR = 140.4 - L and UL full-band SNR = 117.4 - L (Python link budget); the grid covers DL -9.6 ... +64 dB and UL -32.6 ... +41 dB

metric.se_used: per run and direction, over the TBs received in the window (TBs counted by key, erratum 1): SE = sum of TB bits of decoded TBs (corrupt = 0, any rv) / sum over ALL received TBs incl. corrupt and retransmissions of (rb_assigned x 12 x 30 kHz x num_sym x T_sym), T_sym = 0.5 ms / 14. Bits per Hz per second while the direction's data resources are in use; DMRS and HARQ losses are included; PDCCH, guard and TDD duty cycle are not (the E1.3 normalisation: 'PHY rates while the direction's resources are in use')
metric.snr: DL: Python full-band SNR (E1.5.1-verified); UL: Python SNR with n = the TB's rb_assigned; one SNR per run and direction (median over its TBs)
metric.reported: first-transmission BLER, HARQ retransmission share, MCS histogram, SE including the TDD/control share (decoded bits / (51 RB x 12 x 30 kHz x window))

fit.points: per direction and error model, the runs with SNR in [-10, 35] dB and >= 50 TBs in the window
fit.thr_max: maximum measured SE over all runs of that direction and model
fit.alpha: least squares of SE = alpha log2(1 + snr) over the fit points with 0 < SE <= 0.9 Thr_max (closed form)
fit.snr_min: lowest SNR grid point with SE > 0
fit.gap_form_reported: Shannon-gap fit SE = log2(1 + snr / Gamma) on the same points (1-D search, Gamma in dB, 0.01 dB step)
fit.goodness: max and RMS |SE_meas - SE_fit| over the fit points
fit.required_snr: SNR needed for link SE 2.25 (DL) and 1.5 (UL), the F2 thresholds (0.225 / 0.15 bit/s/Hz x 10 users), under TR 36.942, the fitted form and the empirical curve

checks.R3_link_mode_unchanged: scripts/e1_5_2_0_conventions.py rerun with the E1.5.3 build into results/phase2/e1_5_3_link_mapping/r3_e1520_rerun: all checks pass and all 98 raw data files of its 21 runs byte-identical to E1.5.2-0 run 3 (includes the E1.5.1 link-mode rerun R0)
checks.E0_error_model: every run: the gNB DL AMC, gNB UL AMC, gNB and UE decoding error-model instances are all of the requested type
checks.V_snr_identity: every TB of every run: DL |10 log10(m_sinr) - SNR_python| <= 0.01 dB; UL |10 log10(m_sinr) - SNR_python(n = rb_assigned)| <= 0.01 dB
checks.M_mcs_table: t2: every TB has MCS <= 27 and >= 90% of the DL TBs of the lowest-loss run use MCS 27; t1: MCS <= 28 and >= 90% use MCS 28
checks.C_coverage: every run with SNR in [-10, 35] dB in a direction has >= 50 TBs of that direction in the window

decision_rules.valid: R3, E0, V, M and C pass -> the measured curves are the 5G-LENA link mapping
decision_rules.mapping_for_e1_5_5_and_e1c: primary: t2 in the TR 36.942 functional form with the fitted alpha, Thr_max and SNR_min per direction, IF its max |SE_meas - SE_fit| on the fit points is <= 0.3 bit/s/Hz; otherwise the empirical t2 curve (piecewise linear in SNR dB over the grid). Sensitivities: t1 (same rule) and TR 36.942 V19 Table A.1 (legacy)
decision_rules.no_agreement_criterion: disagreement with TR 36.942 is a result, not a failure
decision_rules.stop: R3, E0, V, M or C fails -> stop and diagnose; evidence kept; nothing is changed after results are seen

limits: AWGN (no fading; fading enters through E1.5.2-1's gain distribution), one layer, one UE, ideal control channels, CQI from the exact SINR, no UL power control, 20 MHz
instrument_checks_before_commit: program rebuilt (1 object, no warnings); NrSpectrumPhy's ErrorModelType attribute is set-only, so the decoding model is read back from the instances after the run (e153_error_model.csv); AMC types read back before the run
smoke point (synthetic loss 110 dB, NrEesmIrT2): readbacks all ns3::NrEesmIrT2; 5.7 s, 79 MB; 480 DL and 316 UL TBs in the window
